bio: Hi everyone! My name is Sophie Zeng and I am a first-year staying in Matthews, originally from Houston, Texas. I am planning on concentrating in Computer Science + Economics, but that's up to change! Other than FYSC, I am involved in CBE, HRO, Harmony through PBHA, and HUES. I am so excited to get to know more of our class of 2028 community and plan some fun socials! Feel free to reach out or say hi if you see me!
